issue: Leading/trailing whitespace or lowercase in reservation_id
detection_rule: reservation_id does not fullmatch AR\d{6} before strip+upper
reason: Standard reservation_id format is uppercase AR + 6 digits

issue: Exact duplicate records across 23 business columns
action: Keep first occurrence (keep=first), drop duplicates; record dropped_record_ids_B1
reason: Exact duplicates are data entry errors, not two independent transactions

issue: YYYY-MM-DD date misplaced in booking_status while booking_status_date is empty
action: Transfer value to booking_status_date; leave booking_status empty
reason: Misplaced dates are entry glitches; empty booking_status_date provides sufficient evidence
check_after: booking_status no longer contains date strings

issue: Diverse missing tokens (NULL, N/A, NA, ?, unknown, -) and empty cells
action: Convert to pd.NA; market_segment/sales_channel Undefined → pd.NA
reason: Preserve authentic missingness; avoid mean/mode imputation to prevent analytical bias

field: airline, meal_option, market_segment, sales_channel, fare_policy, traveler_type, booking_status
action: Map via dictionary; unmatched values → pd.NA
reason: Harmonize labels for consistent analysis; Completed=Flown per business convention
check_after: All columns contain only standard labels or NaN

issue: Cabin codes in lowercase or outside valid set
action: Convert to upper(); invalid codes → pd.NA
reason: Standard cabin codes are 2 characters: E1-E4, P1-P2, B1-B3, F1-F3
check_after: cabin code only contains values in CABIN_CODES or NaN

issue: Values formatted as yes/no/True/False/0.0/1.0 instead of integer 0/1
action: Convert to Int64 0/1; ambiguous values → pd.NA
reason: Both flag columns must be integers; Int64 allows nullable NaN

action: When booking_status is valid: Flown→0, Cancelled/No-Show→1
reason: booking_status represents stronger business operational evidence than the is_cancelled flag
check_after: is_cancelled is fully consistent with booking_status

issue: Multiple date formats; dates outside valid range 2024-07-01 to 2026-08-31
action: Parse each format sequentially; out-of-range dates → NaT
reason: Standardize to datetime; do not guess corrupted dates

issue: Dates outside range 2024-01-01 to 2026-09-15 or unparseable
reason: Only ISO YYYY-MM-DD is the standard format for this field

issue: Contained text units (days, pax), decimals, and negative out-of-bound values
detection_rule: Regex integer extraction, bounded by domain constraints
action: Strip text units, cast to Int64, coerce out-of-range values to pd.NA
reason: Ensure clean integer types for computing trip duration and passenger totals
check_after: All integer measure columns cast to Int64 within specified ranges

issue: Contained currency symbols ($/EUR/USD), whitespace, decimal commas, negative/ceiling values
detection_rule: Strip currency, replace commas with dots, float within [0, 5000]
action: Cast to Float64, preserve valid $0 fares, coerce anomalies to pd.NA
reason: Ticket fare is continuous float; $0 fares are valid award/internal tickets per Section 5
check_after: Ticket fares within 0-5000, preserved 13 zero-fare tickets

issue: Full country names in English (Vietnam, China...), lowercase codes (vnm, jpn) or corrupted strings (12A, ??, X)
detection_rule: Map to ISO-3 dictionary, regex validation [A-Z]{2,3}
action: Standardize to 2-3 uppercase ISO codes (VNM, CHN, JPN...); corrupt/unknown values → pd.NA
reason: Harmonize international codes for market share analysis (Question 5); do not guess missing values

issue: Multiple rows sharing the same reservation_id (117 duplicate ID rows)
detection_rule: Group by reservation_id after sorting by record_id
action: Consolidate by reservation_id (keep primary representative row and take first valid values); generate row_lineage.csv
reason: Business rule: 1 booking corresponds to exactly 1 representative data row
check_after: clean has exactly 10000 rows, row_lineage has 10325 rows

field: departure_year/month, total_trip_days, total_passengers, lead_time_group, cabin_changed_flag, booking_value_est
issue: Missing derived indicators required for business analytics and monthly summary
detection_rule: Created strictly following business logic in Section 5.3
action: Computed 7 derived columns: year/month, total trip days, total passengers, lead time group, cabin change flag, booking value
reason: Provide standardized analytical variables for Phase D and management reporting
check_after: All 7 derived columns populated with correct data types

issue: Need monthly aggregation of operational metrics and cancellation rates across both airlines
action: Calculate n_reservations, n_cancelled, cancel_rate_pct (known denominator), passengers_flown
reason: Annual cancellation rate must never be an arithmetic mean of monthly rates; standardized summary
